display.purpose: One-per-fold hero headlines only. Carries the italic-fragment signature.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy. Cap line length at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Mono tracked uppercase. Eyebrows above sections (sparingly), metric labels, chart annotations, mobile menu trigger.

shadows.name: cream
shadows.purpose: Reserved for ProductFrame only. The paper-on-paper hint plus a deep lift that signals 'live system inside'.

shadows.name: glow-advisory
shadows.purpose: Dark-side only. Advisory-state aura around critical telemetry frames. Never on the cream surface.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and sheet entries. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global override under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. All animation- and transition-duration collapse to a single tick.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cream-ink pill with directional chevron. The site's only filled CTA shape.
components.html: Solicitar demo
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0F100E; color: #F7F6F2; font-family: 'Open Runde', Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1F201D; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3D8A7E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent pill with hairline ring. Secondary action paired with the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #0F100E; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #E4E3DC; font-family: 'Open Runde', Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,16,14,0.40); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3D8A7E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mobile Menu Trigger
components.description: Hairline-bordered pill with MENU label in tracked mono caps and a chevron. Inverts to filled on open.
components.css: .ds-menu-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #DEDDD6; background: transparent; color: #0F100E; font-family: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-menu-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] { background: #0F100E; color: #F7F6F2; border-color: #0F100E; } .ds-menu-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] svg { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-menu-trigger svg { transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-menu-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3D8A7E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Frame
components.description: Signature component. Cream-elevated card with traffic-light header and dark control-room interior. The only legitimate cream-to-dark transition.
components.html:
atlaxia.local · pump-3 · en directo
[ live telemetry ]
components.css: .ds-product-frame { border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #E4E3DC, 0 1px 0 rgba(15,16,14,0.04), 0 24px 48px -28px rgba(15,16,14,0.18); background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-product-frame__head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; background: #EFEEE8; border-bottom: 1px solid #E4E3DC; } .ds-product-frame__dots { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-product-frame__dots span { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #E4E3DC; } .ds-product-frame__label { font-family: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #5A5B55; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-product-frame__spacer { width: 48px; } .ds-product-frame__body { background: #0d1117; color: #e6edf3; min-height: 200px; padding: 24px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Operational status chip. Lives inside dark frames only. Tonal background, ring at 30-40%, dot at full saturation.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px currentColor; } .ds-status-pill__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-status-pill--normal { color: #3fb950; background: rgba(63,185,80,0.10); } .ds-status-pill--advisory { color: #58a6ff; background: rgba(88,166,255,0.10); } .ds-status-pill--warning { color: #d29922; background: rgba(210,153,34,0.10); } .ds-status-pill--critical { color: #f85149; background: rgba(248,81,73,0.10); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Cream-elevated with hairline ring. Focus shows the accent-ink outline shared with all interactive elements.
components.css: .ds-input-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Open Runde', Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input-text__label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #1F201D; } .ds-input-text input { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F100E; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #E4E3DC; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input-text input::placeholder { color: #8E8F88; } .ds-input-text input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3D8A7E; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #D6D5CC; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Editorial body-14 anchor in cream-mute. Hover shifts to cream-ink. Used in the desktop nav cluster.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Open Runde', Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #5F605A; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #0F100E; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3D8A7E; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Mono tracked uppercase eyebrow used above sections. Sparingly: three or four per page, never above every section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5F605A; margin: 0; font-feature-settings: 'ss01','ss03'; }

narrative.overview:
AtlaXia lives in two physical spaces and the website is the bridge. The cream surface is the procurement office at four in the afternoon: warm paper, hand-set type, italic anchors in muted teal, sparse mono labels above each section. The dark frames embedded inside that surface are the operations floor at three in the morning: live telemetry, real curves diverging from real thresholds, status pills that mean something. Marketing is the daylight world that explains. The product is the after-hours world that proves. The website holds both, calmly, in one composition.

The voice is attentive and slightly intimate. It is not corporate. It does not perform expertise; it shows working systems. The Spanish copy reads like a careful operator wrote it, not a sales team. Italic teal fragments inside roman headlines do the emotional work that gradients and illustrations do on competing OT sites. The category's reflex is navy and amber; AtlaXia commits to cream and a single muted teal. The category's reflex is stock dashboard screenshots; AtlaXia ships real animated specimens of model behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Two worlds, never blended: cream marketing surface, dark control-room frames embedded as evidence.
One accent only: a single muted teal (oklch(0.62 0.10 165)), used almost exclusively as italic sub-clauses inside roman display headlines. Never as background, never as button fill.
Specimens, not illustrations: every chart animates real model behavior. No icon cards, no stock dashboards.
Hand-set rhythm: numbered taxonomy (01/ 02/ 03/), mono eyebrow labels above sections, varied spacing per fold. The page reads as composed, not templated.
Refuses what the category does: not editorial-magazine-with-a-Cormorant-headline, not navy-and-amber OT, not gradient-on-glass SaaS, not hero-metric grids.

rules.name: The Two Worlds Rule
rules.body: Cream is marketing argument; dark is product evidence. They never blend. A cream surface never contains a dark band; a dark surface never contains a cream patch. The only transitions between worlds are inside a ProductFrame card.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The teal accent appears as italic sub-clauses inside roman display headlines and as a low-opacity gradient halo behind frames. Nowhere else. Not on buttons, not on links, not on borders, not on hover states, not on chart strokes.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: #000 and #fff are forbidden. The ink is #0F100E (cream-ink) or #0d1117 (dark-base). White interiors are reserved for the inside of ProductFrame only.

rules.name: The Italic Fragment Rule
rules.body: The brand's signature gesture: a single italic teal sub-clause inside an otherwise roman display headline. Reserved for the page's two emotional poles: the Hero and the final CTA. Section headlines between hold in roman, using weight contrast (font-semibold + font-normal) for second-line emphasis.

rules.name: The Sparse Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Mono uppercase tracked eyebrow labels are voice, not section grammar. Three or four per page is correct. Above every section is template scaffolding and should be removed.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Any number a reader will compare to another number uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digit widths align.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Every cream surface is flat. Hairline cream-line borders convey grouping; tonal shifts between cream-bg / cream-inset / cream-elevated convey nesting. The only legitimate shadow on the marketing surface is shadow-cream under a ProductFrame.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: When a cream surface needs a visible boundary, use ring-1 ring-cream-line rather than border. Rings do not affect layout box-sizing and read as paper edges, not boxes.

dos: Do use italic teal fragments inside roman display headlines, but only at the Hero and CTA. Section headlines between hold in roman with weight contrast.
Do embed ProductFrame cards as the only legitimate bridge between cream and dark worlds.
Do use cream-mute (#5F605A) for body-size mute text and cream-mute2 (#5A5B55) for the smallest captions. Both pass AA on cream-bg.
Do use tabular-nums on every numeric comparison and metric.
Do keep mobile menu typography at display scale with numbered taxonomy (01/ 02/). The menu is a table of contents, not a hamburger drawer.
Do use Open Runde for display, JetBrains Mono for labels and chart annotations. The pairing is the brand.
Do ship real animations of model behavior. Animations are evidence.
donts: Don't use the OT category reflex palette: navy + amber, gunmetal + safety-orange, terminal-green-on-black. AtlaXia is cream + teal + control-room.
Don't use #000 or #fff. Cream-ink is #0F100E; dark-base is #0d1117; the only legitimate white is the inside of a ProductFrame.
Don't use the teal accent as a button fill, a chart stroke, a hover color, or a background block. Italic ink and gradient halo only.
Don't repeat the mono tracked eyebrow above every section. Sparingly is voice; on every section is AI scaffolding.
Don't add italic-teal fragments to mid-page section headlines. The mid-page voice is roman + font-normal weight contrast on the emphasized line. Italic-teal is reserved for the Hero and the CTA.
Don't ship a hamburger-icon mobile menu. The mobile nav is a numbered typographic sheet at display scale.
Don't use cream-mute3 (#8E8F88) for any text under 18px equivalent. It fails contrast.
Don't introduce border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards, callouts, or alerts.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient. Solid color, weight contrast for emphasis.
Don't ship the SaaS hero-metric template.
Don't ship identical icon-title-text card grids.
Don't wrap chart numerics or inline SVG colors as literal hex. Promote to CSS vars.
Don't use em dashes or en dashes in prose.
Don't name competitors. Comparative copy is structural, not adversarial.
